$Comment: The last rung of Orrin's Vow, and the one that pays his own grimoire: a long sitting at the
greater table, then a Voidheart brought to him.
deep_rites counts pieces the GREATER table took apart (STATION_INPUT, blank Target so any
piece counts, Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table_Greater' on EXACT so the lesser table does not;
the shared unmake_gear TextKey, with the table's name added to the line automatically).
bring_heart is Order 2, an exact-id hand-in of one Voidheart to Orrin only (TurnInNpcId
'giver'). Flow.HideLockedSteps keeps that hand-in off the step list until the sitting is
behind the player, so the quest reads as the work it is asking for.
The heart is a hand-in rather than a station find on purpose: the tables find a Voidheart
only in the deepest gear and rarely, the void's own creatures drop them too, and Orrin's
daily and short order each roll a small chance at one, so the rung has a definite end
whichever road the player takes. Requires names both the rung before it and the greater
table's quest, since the sitting is at that table, plus an Enchanting level gate, the top of
the questline's own curve.
Rewards sit in Claim: Orrin's grimoire itself (Item/Items/MMO_Weapon_Spellbook_Grimoire_Orrin
.json, a working spellbook whose stats are tuned in that file) and Enchanting XP. An Item
reward is fit-checked before the claim goes through, so a full bag parks the claim rather
than eating the book. The Chains entry files it as tier 4 of orrins_vow. Completing this quest
is also what the Orrin's Own achievement counts, so a retune here changes what that
achievement asks. Remove the Item entry and the questline is a plain XP arc.
Name: The_Voidheart
